description: Supply network analyser with RS485 Modbus RTU: present, maximum and minimum values of voltages, currents, powers, power factor, frequency, THD and flicker, energies and harmonics
source: Circutor, Supply network analyzer CVM-BDM series instruction manual, M98153001-03, section 12.3 MODBUS protocol

sources.title: Supply network analyzer CVM-BDM series, instruction manual
sources.note: section 12.3, Modbus registers, example, relay and reset functions

notes: Circutor CVM-BDM series. Registers of section 12.3 of the manual.
Each parameter is a 32-bit value in two registers, high word first (as in the manual's example). Functions 03 and 04 both read them.

Units follow the manual: voltages in V x 10, currents in mA (harmonic fundamental currents in A), powers in W, var and VA, power factor x 100, frequency, THD, flicker and harmonics x 10, energies in Wh and varh.
Relays are read with function 01 and set with function 05; the reset commands are function 05 writes of FF00 to the listed addresses.
